changes.summary: Aligned the default with MiaAI-Lab's announced and tested 900K two-Spark profile.
changes.details: Pins the first immutable upstream 900K revision and packages its QSA NVFP4-KV patches, YaRN extension, 28 request slots, automatic PLE placement, 1024-token prefill chunks, and MTP3 settings.

changes.summary: Added an executable two-Spark Qwen3.8 Flash Next NVFP4 SGLang Candidate.
changes.details: The recipe pins all 135,253,622,894 model bytes and rebuilds the public MiaAI-Lab QSA fallback on an immutable ARM64 SGLang image with exact NCCL 2.30.7, native TP2 rendezvous, PLE offload, bounded 262K context, and MTP3.
